# Targets

Approved target technologies for modernization. Defines *what is approved* — not implementation steps.

## Target Frameworks

| Language | Target Version | Notes |
|----------|---------------|-------|
| All | Latest stable | Always target the latest stable version of all packages and dependencies |

## Target Data Services

| Service | Use When |
|---------|----------|
| Azure SQL | Relational workloads requiring SQL Server compatibility |
| Azure Database for PostgreSQL | Relational workloads requiring PostgreSQL compatibility |
| Azure Cosmos DB | Non-relational / globally distributed workloads |
